prompt: customer won't let any of their data leave their azure tenant, but we built everything on AWS/Bedrock. what actually has to move and what can stay? we're on LangGraph with postgres checkpointing, and we self-host langfuse already so I think we're covered on traces.

assertions.text: States the model endpoint must move inside the tenant (Azure AI Foundry / Azure OpenAI)
States log and audit destinations must also live inside the tenant, not just the app/DB/traces
CATCHES THE PLANTED GAP: identifies the LangGraph postgres CHECKPOINTS as a client-data store that must move and that retains full document content (ideally noting no default TTL / needs a purge job)
Does not simply accept the user's 'we're covered on traces' framing — probes what else holds payloads
Warns about Azure Global vs Regional/Data-Zone model deployment (the residency trap on the Azure side), or equivalently that the default deployment option may not be regionally bounded
Identifies what CAN stay outside: artifacts containing no client data (CI/CD, images, IaC, source)
Notes Azure BAA/data-use coverage must be re-established in writing rather than assumed from the AWS posture
